extracted_verbatim: An order block is the last opposing candle before an impulsive move - the last bearish (down-close) candle before a bullish push for a bullish order block, the last bullish (up-close) candle before a bearish push for a bearish order block.
finding: All ten records are tier 5. No primary written specification by the originator was located; every operational statement retrieved is a secondary restatement by a broker, vendor or educator site. The zone bounds - candle body versus candle high-low - are not agreed across the ten sources.
